welcome.subheadline: Build the foundations of a stronger crop with nitrogen from the air.
welcome.intro: VIXERAN® helps Oilseed Rape unlock an additional source of biologically fixed nitrogen during the most critical stage of establishment.

bioEngineers.title: How VIXERAN® Works
bioEngineers.body1: VIXERAN® contains Azotobacter salinestris, a naturally occurring endophytic bacterium that colonises the plant from within.
bioEngineers.body2: It captures atmospheric nitrogen and converts it into ammonium, providing an additional source of nitrogen when the crop needs it most.

benefits.nitrogen: Unlocks additional nitrogen from the air

trials.title: Interactive Trial Map & Weather Dashboard
trials.lead: Explore field trials across Europe and see how VIXERAN® performs in different growing conditions.
trials.source: Source: 51 ARM Single Trial Reports (AT, DE, DK, FR, GB, LT, PL, SE), winter oilseed rape 2022–2025. Products: VIXERAN® / NutribioN (Azotobacter salinestris CECT 9690) and the experimental codes A23780 / A19464. Weather data: MeteoBlue hourly export.
